newsitem.title: UK: Crude tankers stable, Mideast-Korea trade active.
newsitem.headline: Crude tankers stable, Mideast-Korea trade active.

text.p: Crude oil tanker chartering rates were mostly stable on Tuesday, brokers said.
Rates for Very Large and Ultra Large Crude Carriers (ULCCs and VLCCs) on voyages from from the Mideast to the Far east held steady with active trade to South Korea seen at around W63.
Rates in other regions were mostly stable although trade on West African transatlantic, cross UKC and cross Med routes was thin.
The UKC market saw several majors booking Aframax tonnage and prices were marked slightly firmer with two Sture liftings taking W110 one to Whitgate the other Milford Haven.
Mediterranean rates were harder to pin down with ERG booking two cargoes and Conoco one into Italy, but no rates were reported.
In the Mideast Gulf market Vela booked a ULCC and a VLCC to the U.S. Gulf taking its tally to five since last Friday.
The Sahara, 350,000 tonnes, took a steady W47.5 while the Estelle Maersk with 285,0000 tonnes was pegged back to W47.5. -- Colin Wooster, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7456
